name: Essam Fadel
role: I develop BIM, data-space and human–machine systems for construction.

experience.organisation: Chair of Intelligent Technical Design · Bauhaus-Universität Weimar
experience.summary: Research and teaching focused on digital construction processes, BIM and data management.
Developing and integrating digital methods, innovation projects and technology solutions across the planning, construction and operations value chain.

experience.organisation: Chair of Intelligent Technical Design · Bauhaus-Universität Weimar
experience.summary: Supported research through simulation, virtual and mixed reality, teaching preparation and documentation.
Coordinated construction work packages for a structural-concrete project, including planning, scheduling and cost monitoring.

projects.name: Handwerk der Zukunft
projects.summary: Data-driven planning and human-robot interaction for work in existing buildings. The research links 3D capture, condition assessment and marking tasks with planning data and a mobile robot assistant.

projects.name: Construct-X
projects.summary: A research project developing an open, federated construction data space and cloud-edge reference architecture for secure, sovereign, near-real-time data exchange across the sector.

projects.name: EConoM
projects.summary: Tested 5G campus networks, edge computing, AI and digital twins to support the automation and optimisation of construction-site processes. Work included BIMSWARM marketplace and edge-infrastructure integration.

projects.name: BIMSWARM
projects.summary: An open, vendor-neutral platform connecting applications, services and content for BIM-based planning, construction and operation. Contributions included further development, project management and CI/CD operations.

projects.name: BIMKIT
projects.summary: An AI- and cloud-enabled approach to generating digital as-built models from existing building and infrastructure data. Contributions included IFC and JSON-IFC services and platform integration.

projects.name: BIM-SPEED
projects.summary: A European project advancing BIM for renovation through interoperable tools and an open, cost-effective platform. Work included BIM requirements, the BIM Passport, a maturity tool and BIM execution-plan concepts.

projects.name: DigitalTWIN
projects.summary: Digital tools and workflows for connecting and automating the building lifecycle through an open, continuous platform for object and process data. Contributions included mixed-reality, 4D VR and immersive IFC-web-viewer work.

publications.title: A Data-Space-Oriented Architecture for Craft-Oriented Construction
